# NexBotix - WhatsApp MCP Server & AI Automation Platform

> NexBotix is the premier enterprise platform for integrating WhatsApp with AI Agents via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling automated customer support, OTP delivery, bulk messaging, and agentic workflows.

## About NexBotix
NexBotix provides a streamable HTTP Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that connects modern AI development environments and agents—including Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, and custom LLM applications—directly to WhatsApp messaging infrastructure.

- **Website**: https://nexbotix.todayintech.in
- **API Documentation**: https://nexbotix.todayintech.in/docs
- **Blog & Tutorials**: https://nexbotix.todayintech.in/blog
- **Free Trial**: 3-day unlimited trial with full API access upon signup (no credit card required)

## Core Features & Capabilities

### 1. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Integration
- **Streamable HTTP MCP Endpoint**: Connect AI agents to WhatsApp without complex webhook setups or server management.
- **Built-in AI Tools**: Expose standardized tools to LLMs: `send_message`, `read_messages`, `check_contact_status`, `send_bulk_broadcast`, and `get_analytics`.
- **Supported IDEs & Clients**: Claude Desktop, Cursor AI, Windsurf IDE, Continuing, and custom MCP clients.

### 2. WhatsApp Bulk Messaging & Broadcast Infrastructure
- **High-Volume Delivery**: Enterprise-grade messaging engine with smart throttling, anti-ban protection, and number rotation.
- **Dynamic Variables**: Personalize broadcasts with custom fields, media attachments (images, PDFs, videos), and interactive buttons.
- **Real-Time Analytics**: Track delivery rates, read receipts, link clicks, and response metrics in real time.

### 3. AI Bot Health & Diagnostic Tools
- **Bot Detection & Uptime**: Built-in diagnostics at `/check-chatbot` to test bot responsiveness, latency, and session health.
- **Automated Failover**: Ensure 99.99% uptime for mission-critical customer support and transactional alerts.

### 4. Website-to-WhatsApp Lead Conversion
- **AI Web Widget**: Embeddable chatbot for websites that automatically captures visitor queries and converts them into instant WhatsApp conversations.
